reviewed.section: Block 2, Inputs (NOT_FEELING_100, READINESS_DECLARATION, RESTART_PLAN) and Security questions

baseline_read.note: Runtime line numbers are those of commit 4584a77 (HEAD). Another author was editing r6-adaptation.mjs and r6-clinical.mjs (Block 1) in the working tree during this review; those uncommitted edits were not reviewed and these conditions do not depend on them.

25-34 eligibility: six clinical flags, 14-day currency, UNASSESSED when flags unknown
147 screenInterruptionReason: free text can only add CLINICAL or ASK
ONB-05, ONB-11, ONB-15, SURF-13, FLOW-15, ST-CONS, DEG-23, AG-12, RUN-08, STR-05, SHR-08, CTN-08, DEP-08

verdict.scope: the F08 input design of DESIGN_V1CP r1 as amended by the dispositions below; design level only, nothing implemented or verified at runtime
changes_required_from_draft: SEC-V1CP-05 (drop free text from the F08 inputs)
verdict.not_ready_for_exposure_until: every condition with trigger BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION is reflected in the integration contract and every condition with trigger BEFORE_EXPOSURE has its evidence; Security re-verifies at implementation (SEC-V1CP-25)
verdict.invalidated_by: a change to the Block 2 inputs, to the purposes, to who can read the record, or to any outbound surface (share, export, notification, analytics, LLM, HealthKit write)

fields.note: Self-reported category, not a diagnosis. No subtypes (no named illness, symptom list, medication or cause). The app never derives or shows a diagnostic label from it.
UPPER_BODY / LOWER_BODY is the finest body granularity allowed. No joint, side or anatomical site.
Necessary: the S2w versus S3 safety routing consumes them. Each starts unanswered and is actively answered; a declined answer is unknown (ASK), never no. Stored as answered within the episode only.
Unchanged instrument; same no-prefill rule.
A training preference; health data by association with the episode.
Dates of the episode; health data by association.
A training preference.

Every consumer is covered by the structured fields and the explicit red flags. Free text invites diagnoses, medication and third parties' health ('my mother had surgery'), the most sensitive and least minimised content, for no decision the booleans do not already make. Re-entry only under SEC-V1CP-05.
Opaque, non-semantic (encodes no reason, region or date), ownership checked on the server.

Closed vocabulary AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH | AVOID_UPPER_BODY_STRENGTH only: functional, not diagnostic. No free-text restriction, no attribution to a professional ('my doctor said').
Fresh, actively answered, dated on or after the episode's last day and after its latest clinical sign; never copied from an earlier screen.

It records that a medical encounter happened (health data), reads as a proxy clearance, invites coercion ('say you saw a doctor') and drifts into a gate. The restriction vocabulary already carries what a professional told the athlete, in functional terms.
Existing intake fields only; eligibility re-asked fresh under the existing rules.

fields.field: F08 states (S2w, S3, S6, S8 by cause), HOLD reasons, decision reason strings, screen outcome and matched terms
fields.note: Derived health inferences. The decision reason at r6-adaptation.mjs:738 embeds matched clinical words.

fields.field: inputHash and any hash of these facts
fields.note: Hashes of low-entropy enums and booleans are reversible by enumeration: they are the facts, not anonymous ids.

conditions.title: Classification
conditions.rule: Every F08 input, the baseline interruption facts and eligibility, and everything derived from them (states, HOLD reasons, decision and explanation text, screen outcomes, matched terms, hashes) are sensitive personal data about health (LGPD art. 5 II, art. 11). The data inventory lists each with purpose, source and derived uses.
conditions.evidence: inventory rows purpose -> data -> derived for every field in this record

conditions.title: Closed structure, fail closed
conditions.rule: Only the closed enums, booleans and dates in this record. No diagnosis, medication, exam, symptom list, body site finer than UPPER/LOWER, or professional's name. Unknown or extra values are rejected by the core and the server and become ASK, never a default. Any vocabulary extension needs SSCTR and Security.
conditions.evidence: schema with additionalProperties false; rejection tests for unknown values

conditions.title: No prefilled health answers
conditions.rule: Red flags, eligibility flags and the clinicalReason confirmation start unanswered and are actively answered one by one. No 'all no' shortcut, no copy from a previous screen, no default. A declined or skipped answer is unknown (ASK): never no, never clearance, never an assumed disease.
conditions.evidence: UI test that submission without every answer is refused; core test unknown -> ASK

conditions.title: professionalSeen dropped
conditions.rule: Not collected in any form: boolean, free text, professional's name or council number, date of visit, or 'my doctor allowed'. Re-entry needs a named decision consumer, PCG, Security and G07.
conditions.evidence: field absent from DESIGN and integration contract

conditions.title: No free text in the F08 inputs
conditions.rule: NOT_FEELING_100 and READINESS_DECLARATION offer no free text in V1. Re-entry only if the SSCTR shows a red-flag consumer the booleans miss; then SEC-V1CP-06 and SEC-V1CP-07 apply.
conditions.evidence: field absent from DESIGN and integration contract

conditions.title: Handling of the baseline free text
conditions.rule: Optional; bounded at input (Engineering sets the bound; statedReason already uses 200 characters); read only by the deterministic screen in the core, which may only add CLINICAL or ASK; never sent to an LLM, translation, moderation, search, analytics or any third party; never a classifier beyond that screen; output-encoded wherever displayed; stored only in the athlete's own record.
conditions.evidence: bound enforced in core and server; data-flow diagram with no outbound path for the text

conditions.title: Deleting text never reclassifies
conditions.rule: The athlete can edit or delete a free-text note. The screen outcome persists as a structured fact without the text, so deleting or editing never turns a clinical-cause episode nonclinical (R-F08-1).
conditions.evidence: regression: CLINICAL screen, delete text, episode still clinical-cause

conditions.title: Purpose limitation
conditions.rule: Allowed purposes: adapting the athlete's training (reduction, hold, restart, new plan), the athlete's own history and explanations, and the safety routing to professional assessment. Forbidden without a separate specific consent and a G07 basis: marketing, growth, ads, referral, pricing, offers, entitlement, analytics, secondary learning I10, research, model training, LLM prompts, HealthKit write, notification content, any transfer or sale.
conditions.evidence: purpose register entry; no consumer outside the allowed list in the integration contract

conditions.title: Analytics see no cause
conditions.rule: Product analytics (DR-132) may count planned, adapted and completed sessions. They never receive the condition, scope, red flags, intent, F08 state names, episode reasons, or the fact that the check-in was used. A reduced week counts through the plan fact 'adapted', not its cause.
conditions.evidence: event schema review: no F08 field or derived label

conditions.title: Consent
conditions.rule: Specific and highlighted consent for one stated purpose ('use what you tell us about how you feel to adapt your training'), asked at the point of first use, by an explicit act, not prechecked and not bundled with terms, Apple Health or I10. Recorded with language and text version (SEC-J3-06, FLOW-15). PT-BR, EN and ES equivalent. Whether one purpose covers ONB-11, eligibility and F08 together, and the final legal basis, are G07.
conditions.owner: Product/UX; final text and basis G07
conditions.evidence: consent record with language and version; copy in three languages

conditions.title: Refusal keeps training usable and safe
conditions.rule: Without this consent the athlete can still skip or rest any session (a training action that stores no health fact), sees a generic 'if you are unwell, seek professional assessment' message, and keeps history and rights (DEG-23). Refusal is never treated as clearance or as illness. The training posture under unknown health status is the existing UNASSESSED/ASK path (SSCTR owns it) and is never less conservative than the path with health data.
conditions.evidence: flow defined in the integration contract; core test of the refused path

conditions.title: Revocation fails conservative
conditions.rule: Revocation stops future collection and processing for the purpose (AG-12). Open F08 states move to the unknown-health posture, which is never less conservative than the state it replaces: revoking never exits S3 or S6 into normal progression and never restores prior doses. Whether a minimal clinical-cause marker may be kept after revocation, and on what basis, is G07.
conditions.owner: Engineering with SSCTR; G07 for the marker
conditions.evidence: regression: S3 then revoke, no progression and no prior doses

conditions.title: Retention and deletion
conditions.rule: These facts live only in the account's training record while they serve the purpose. There are no side copies (caches, analytics, exports to staff, test fixtures from production). They are deleted with the account (DR-108) and on the athlete's request per episode. No duration is invented here: periods and legal exceptions are G07.
conditions.evidence: deletion path covers record, replicas and backups per the G07 schedule

conditions.title: Erasure fails closed in a hash-bound record
conditions.rule: The record is append-only and hash-bound: readableDeclaration (r6-adaptation.mjs:759) silently drops a row whose inputHash does not match, and programHash covers decisions whose reasons embed matched terms (738). Erasure of a health payload therefore needs a designed tombstone that the core reads as clinical-cause or unknown, never as absent or nonclinical, and that keeps integrity checking. An erased episode must never unlock a nonclinical recipe or restore prior doses.
conditions.evidence: tombstone design plus regression: erase a clinical-cause episode, core stays clinical-cause or unknown

conditions.title: Hashes are the facts
conditions.rule: inputHash and any hash or fingerprint of these facts are handled as the facts: never logged, exported, used in analytics or presented as an anonymous identifier.
conditions.evidence: log and analytics schema review

conditions.title: No health values in logs, telemetry or crash reports
conditions.rule: No condition, scope, red flag, eligibility flag, intent, restriction, readiness, free text, F08 state, HOLD or decision reason, matched term, or episodeId-to-state link in client or server logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, breadcrumbs, captured view text, screenshots or network logs. Request-body logging is off for these routes. Crash SDKs scrub before upload.
conditions.evidence: canary test: unique canary values submitted through every F08 path, then searched for in all log, crash and telemetry sinks

conditions.title: Operating-system surfaces stay neutral
conditions.rule: Push text and payloads, lock screen, widgets, Live Activities, Spotlight and Siri donations, Handoff and the clipboard never name the condition, a red flag, a restriction, an illness or injury, or clinical wording. Neutral text only ('Seu plano foi ajustado'). Screens showing these details SHOULD be obscured in the app-switcher snapshot.
conditions.evidence: notification template review in three languages; no donation of these screens

conditions.title: Shareables and exports
conditions.rule: Growth Layer artifacts (DR-124 to DR-133), weekly, PR and progress shares, their file names, alt text and metadata never carry these facts or any derived label ('comeback after injury', 'back from illness'). A reduced week shows only what was done, and no content is generated automatically from an episode. Outbound projections (calendar, HealthKit write, future watch or Crew) carry none. The athlete's own access and portability export (SURF-13) includes them, labelled, only after reauthentication (G08/G09).
conditions.evidence: share allowlist excludes every field and label; export test behind reauth

conditions.title: Athlete-only access, enforced on the server
conditions.rule: Read and write are authorized on the server by the account, never by the frontend alone. episodeId is opaque, and ownership is checked on every read and write; cross-account read or write is denied. V1 has no staff, coach or support view and no default staff access. Operational database access is least-privilege, audited and break-glass only. Debugging uses synthetic data, never production records.
conditions.evidence: negative tests: other account's episodeId read and write denied; access-control review

conditions.title: Protection at rest and in transit
conditions.rule: TLS in transit; encrypted at rest on the server, with field-level encryption SHOULD for these facts (G09). On the device: iOS Data Protection on the record and the offline queue, never in UserDefaults, plists or caches readable before first unlock. Backup handling follows G09.
conditions.evidence: storage review; file protection class recorded

conditions.title: Copy never claims clearance or diagnosis
conditions.rule: Never 'liberado', 'liberação', 'alta', 'apto', 'autorizado', 'aprovado por', 'cleared', 'approved by', 'released', 'fit to train', 'dado de alta', 'apto para entrenar', or any equivalent. Never assert recovery or name a condition as the app's finding. Readiness reads as the athlete's own statement ('Você informou que está pronto para recomeçar'). No claim of professional supervision. S3 says that a professional assessment is recommended. Red flags such as chest pain or fainting carry urgent-care guidance (copy: PCG/SSCTR; legal G07/G11). The app never produces a screen, file or certificate usable as proof of readiness or clearance.
conditions.owner: Product/UX copy with PCG; G07/G11 final
conditions.evidence: string scan of the PT-BR, EN and ES catalogs against the denylist; no readiness artifact

conditions.title: Readiness declaration integrity
conditions.rule: Accepted only for the athlete's own episode in S3, with a fresh eligibility screen dated on or after the episode's last day and after its latest clinical sign. Append-only, never edits the reason (R-F08-1), replays deduplicated by eventId, enforced in the core and on the server. A new sign after the declaration returns to S3. Device-owner authentication for the declaration SHOULD exist for shared devices (G09 decides).
conditions.evidence: tests: another athlete's episode refused; stale screen refused; replay is a no-op

conditions.title: A restart plan is not a bypass
conditions.rule: A new plan never clears an S3 hold or an active restriction: a clinical-cause episode in S3 needs its readiness declaration first, enforced in the core, not only in the UI. The carried record goes by reference, with minimal carry (see the carried record field).
conditions.evidence: regression: RESTART_PLAN during S3 refused or held

conditions.title: No medical document in V1
conditions.rule: No upload, photo, camera capture, scan or OCR, file picker, link field, or request to send by e-mail or messaging for any medical document (atestado, laudo, exam, prescription, or an image of one), in any flow, support included. A document received spontaneously is not attached to the record and is disposed of per the support procedure (G07). Any need for a document escalates to the Founder (task contract).
conditions.owner: Chief and Product/UX; support procedure G07
conditions.evidence: integration contract has no such control; support macro reviewed

conditions.title: Verification before exposure
conditions.rule: The tests named under SEC-V1CP-02, 03, 07, 12, 14, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22 and 23 run on the implementation, and Security re-verifies the boundary on that implementation. This design-level gate is not a runtime approval.
conditions.evidence: test results on the implementation revision; Security record

conditions.title: Health facts do not drive commerce, and safety is never paywalled
conditions.rule: No health fact is used for pricing, offers, upsell timing or entitlement. The red-flag routing, the professional-assessment recommendation and the hold work in every entitlement state. Whether the reductions themselves are a paid feature is G10.
conditions.evidence: entitlement matrix shows the safety route ungated

conditions.title: Age gate unchanged
conditions.rule: The F08 flows never re-ask or infer age, and never hint at a way around the 18+ gate (ONB-03). If the athlete is known to be a minor, the G08 procedure applies. Whether a self-declared age is adequate for sensitive data is G07/G08.
conditions.evidence: flow review

abuse_cases.case: False 'ready' declaration to escape a clinical hold
abuse_cases.mitigation: Cannot be verified by the Founder's decision (D2: no document). Proportionate friction: a fresh, actively answered screen; a conservative restart by the episode's own length (CONSERVATIVE or BALANCED only, SSCTR); restrictions as hard caps; any new sign returns to S3; the copy states it is the athlete's own declaration and recommends assessment.
abuse_cases.residual: ACCEPTED_BY_FOUNDER_D2: the app relies on the adult athlete's honesty

abuse_cases.case: Red flags answered 'no' while symptomatic, or skipped to reach the reduction
abuse_cases.mitigation: No prefill and no shortcut; unknown is ASK; red flags are specific and visible; a 'yes' leads to S3 with urgent-care guidance where relevant.

abuse_cases.case: Coercion: a partner, coach, employer, gym or race organizer demands proof of readiness or watches health state
abuse_cases.mitigation: V1 has no third-party view, the app produces no proof or certificate, shareables and notifications carry nothing, and the export sits behind reauthentication.
abuse_cases.residual: someone with the unlocked phone can still look; see AB-04

abuse_cases.case: Shared or borrowed device: another person sees episodes or submits a declaration
abuse_cases.mitigation: Neutral OS surfaces, app-switcher obscuring, device-owner authentication SHOULD for the declaration, and reauthentication MUST for the export.
abuse_cases.residual: an unlocked device in another person's hands; an optional app lock is G09

abuse_cases.case: Escaping a hold by deleting free text, revoking consent, erasing the episode or starting a new plan
abuse_cases.mitigation: Classification persists without the text; revocation and erasure fail conservative and closed; RESTART_PLAN is refused or held in S3.
abuse_cases.residual: none at design level; needs the regression tests

abuse_cases.mitigation: The 18+ gate before identity is unchanged; no age inference from health data; dropping free text removes a channel where age is revealed in passing; G08 procedure when known.

abuse_cases.case: Cross-account access or replay (IDOR on episodeId, a stale declaration resent)
abuse_cases.mitigation: Server ownership checks, an opaque id, eventId deduplication and the screen-date rule.

abuse_cases.case: Injection through free text into a future staff view or LLM
abuse_cases.mitigation: Free text is dropped from F08; the baseline text is bounded, output-encoded and never sent to an LLM or a third party.

abuse_cases.case: Leakage through telemetry, crash reports, hashes or notifications (health inference by vendors or anyone glancing at the lock screen)
abuse_cases.mitigation: Canary-tested scrubbing; hashes treated as the facts; neutral push text.
abuse_cases.residual: vendor selection and contracts are G07

abuse_cases.case: Growth or commerce exploiting the episode (a 'comeback' share, an upsell while ill)
abuse_cases.mitigation: Purpose limitation, share exclusion and commerce exclusion.

legal_owner_items_G07: Legal basis for each operation: art. 11 I (specific, highlighted consent) for the adaptation; whether any art. 11 II hypothesis (for example protection of life or physical safety) covers the red-flag routing or the retention of a clinical-cause marker after revocation or erasure (SEC-V1CP-12, SEC-V1CP-14).
Whether one consent purpose may cover ONB-11, the eligibility screen and F08 together, and the final consent text in PT-BR, EN and ES (SEC-V1CP-10).
Retention periods, deletion timelines and legal exceptions (art. 16), including backups (SEC-V1CP-13, DR-108).
A data protection impact report (RIPD, art. 38) for these sensitive flows before real collection: recommended.
Processors and international transfer (hosting, crash and analytics vendors; art. 33 if hosted abroad), and their contracts (SEC-V1CP-16).
Adequacy of self-declared 18+ for sensitive health data, with G08 (SEC-V1CP-27).

Whether the red-flag screen and the professional-assessment routing fall under any health-software, medical-device or professional-council regulation in Brazil, given the V1 positioning of automated suggestions without human supervision: outside the security role.
Final copy and disclaimers, with G11 claims (SEC-V1CP-21); the support procedure for documents received spontaneously (SEC-V1CP-24).

escalations.note: Neither escalation trigger fired. The legal items above are routed to G07, not decided here.

not_done: No runtime, test, Figma or repository file outside this folder was changed. No verification was run on an implementation (none exists). No legal determination was made.
